config.description: Freight Analysis Framework: FAF5.7.1 regional (FAF zone) and state origin-destination flows by SCTG2 commodity, mode and trade type (tons, value, current value, ton-miles; 2017-2024 plus 2030-2050 baseline forecasts), FAF6.0 state 2022 benchmark, FAF5.7.1 reprocessed 1997/2002/2007/2012 state history (38,901,646 bytes) and state low/high forecast scenarios (203,448,107 bytes). desired_bytes temporarily also covers the superseded three-file artifact (457,486,055 bytes) until it is retired after the rebuild.

source.publisher: USDOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics and Federal Highway Administration; Oak Ridge National Laboratory (FAF)
source.release: FAF5.7.1 (2017 base, 2018-2024 annual estimates, 2030-2050 baseline/low/high forecasts; reprocessed 1997, 2002, 2007, 2012 state history); FAF6.0 state (2022 benchmark, published 2026-08)
source.unit_notes: Tons in thousand short tons; FAF5 value in million 2017 constant dollars (current_value in million current dollars); FAF6.0 value in million 2022 dollars; ton-miles in millions. All values are modeled estimates, not survey counts.
